fields.title: Size scaling and optimality
fields.finding: Only the two checked f5 gyration families are assessed. Larger manufactured tubes and thermal interactions are not validated.
fields.proposed_fix: Search further sections/topologies using independently checked force/eigen solutions and manufacturing limits before claiming a global radius minimum.

claim: Only the two checked f5 gyration families are assessed. Larger manufactured tubes and thermal interactions are not validated. | Size scaling and optimality
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
